verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an LLM inference platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents Groq's hosted cloud API (api.groq.com base URL, service tiers, and batch/flex processing on Groq's infrastructure), with no on-prem or self-hosted deployment option. Open-weight models and client SDKs do not amount to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
